summary: ArrayString::try_push formed a mutable byte slice over potentially uninitialized storage. The fix passes a raw pointer and remaining capacity to encode_utf8 and initializes bytes using ptr::write. Blocked: the added char::test_encode_utf8 and char::test_encode_utf8_oob tests use initialized buffers and do not demonstrate the uninitialized-memory issue; the existing test_string_push checks string contents and capacity without establishing detection of this issue. A verbatim reversal of encode_utf8 also restores its two-argument signature, breaking the unchanged three-argument calls in the added tests. No valid implementation-only reversal and detecting test could be established under these constraints. No builds or tests were run.
